description: The dry run of a merge: what each item would do. It changes nothing.

key.description: Identifies the item: <part>:<id> (for example proxy_hosts:3), setting:<group> or file:<path>. The keys of the choices field of a restore use it.

type.description: The backup part the item belongs to.

id.description: The item's id in the backup; null for a settings group or a file.

label.description: What the item is called in lists: the domains, name, port or email.

action.description: What a merge would do with the item

reason.description: Why the item meets one on this instance: domain-in-use, domain-in-use-several, port-in-use, same-certificate, same-email or same-name; null when it meets none.

target.description: The item on this instance that it meets (type, id, label); null when it meets none.

choices.description: The choices the item offers, the first is the default. Empty when there is nothing to choose.

default.description: The choice used when none is sent; null when the item offers none.

needed_by.description: The keys of the chosen items that need this one (a linked certificate, access list or DNS credential).

linked.description: Whether the item is only here because a chosen item needs it.

unticked.description: Present and true when the choice left a linked item out (choice unticked).

items.description: Every item of the chosen parts, with what a merge would do with it.

replace.description: Items that replace an existing one.

existing.description: Items that use the matching existing one.

take.description: Settings and files taken from the backup.

keep.description: Settings and files kept as this instance has them.

cleared_links.description: Links that are cleared because their target is not kept

key.description: The key of the item whose link is cleared.

column.description: The column that loses its value, for example certificate_id.

from.description: The id the column held in the backup.

label.description: The cleared target, as it is called in the backup.

needs_secrets.description: Keys of the items that need secrets the file does not have

hash.description: Identifies the plan; send it as plan_hash to apply it
